tasks.short: Investigate security incidents from preserved evidence

steps.what: Preserve incident evidence and check source provenance
Investigate incident causes and test competing explanations

tasks.design: Configure the forensic analysis tool in {OTHER} to compile source-linked event timelines from preserved records. The tester retains evidence capture, clock interpretation, exception handling and root-cause judgement, recording conclusions in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual event collation can consume time before competing incident explanations are tested.
tasks.enabler_now: Native timeline exports and fixed parsers can order known event fields while preserving source references.
tasks.still_hard: Missing evidence, clock discrepancies, misleading events and distinguishing correlation from cause.
tasks.human_edge: The investigator tests explanations and knows when the available evidence cannot support a conclusion.
tasks.altitude: Less event collation; investigation decisions and evidential responsibility stay with the tester.

reach.learn: Evidence handling and clock uncertainty analysis

evidence.claim: Native forensic timeline compilation from known event schemas is plausible; its proposed time saving is unmeasured.
Eye Security describes AI-supported managed detection and response with analyst decisions; this does not establish forensic timeline savings.

assumptions: Boundary is evidence preservation, event collation and incident interpretation; containment changes and remediation are outside it.

OTHER means the existing forensic analysis tool. The tester produces and checks the source manifest in s1: source identifier, evidence location, integrity reference, event schema, timestamp field, recorded timezone and known clock uncertainty. All acquisition, schema selection and field capture time is counted there.

Existing source systems produce raw event identifiers, timestamps and event bodies during normal logging; no new logging deployment is assumed. The configured parser preserves raw timestamps, source references and uncertainty, sorts only interpretable events and lists failures. Unknown schemas or clock mappings are manually handled in s3, never guessed.
Try native timeline tools first. Already automatic compilation earns zero new saving; source-system runtime is not labour.
research_questions: How much manual event compilation remains after native tooling, including parser failures and clock checks?

already_counted.description: Evidence capture, manifest checks, investigation and parser exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain parser configurations and verify sampled timelines against source evidence

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gives gross20 and net12 after8 upkeep. Range2-7% assumes recurring manually collated supported records, allowing clock and parser exceptions; no reduction in cause analysis.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop scoped infiltration tests for device weaknesses

steps.what: Analyse device vulnerabilities and choose infiltration test objectives
Develop and validate infiltration tests in the assessment environment

tasks.design: Keep test objectives and procedure development with the tester in {DOCS} and the assessment tools in {OTHER}. The tester validates the exact procedure against scope and expected observations before handing it over.
tasks.previous_blocker: A vulnerability description does not determine a valid test for a particular device and environment.
tasks.enabler_now: Assisted testing exists, but no unmeasured development shortcut is treated as a labour saving here.
tasks.still_hard: Building a meaningful, reproducible test that respects scope and distinguishes failure modes.
tasks.human_edge: The tester connects device behaviour to a valid test and recognises unintended effects.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in test design responsibility.

reach.learn: Device constraints and controlled test design

evidence.claim: Aikido Security offers AI pentesting, but this digest does not show reduced labour for designing device-specific infiltration tests.

assumptions: Boundary is test development and validation in the assessment environment, excluding production execution and separate finding documentation.

OTHER means existing assessment development tools. The assessment owner provides scope and environment access before s1; the tester derives objectives and constraints in s1 and develops the procedure in s2. No machine action or new structured-input contract is introduced.
Existing native test tooling remains in the baseline; runtime is not human labour.
Zero incremental upkeep because no additional component or recurring work is proposed.
research_questions: Which test-development activities remain repetitive after existing tools and validated procedures are used?

already_counted.description: Objective selection, procedure development and validation

approvals.approved_version: Exact procedure version, device scope, test conditions, expected observations and stop conditions; changes void validation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross and net0. Procedure development and validation remain human; no savings from existing test runtime.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design security solutions for known device vulnerabilities

steps.what: Analyse device vulnerabilities, dependencies and operational constraints
Design security solutions and assess residual vulnerability exposure

tasks.design: Retain vulnerability interpretation and solution design as human work in {DOCS}. The tester proposes controls, operational tradeoffs and verification criteria for the system owner.
tasks.previous_blocker: A generic remedy may conflict with device support, availability or legitimate usage.
tasks.enabler_now: No additional component is proposed without evidence of a repetitive design subtask.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing a workable control and understanding the remaining exposure.
tasks.human_edge: The tester balances the demonstrated weakness against the actual system's operating needs.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in design responsibility or authority.

reach.task: Prepare a control design with explicit verification criteria
reach.learn: Implementation constraints and residual risk assessment

evidence.claim: Device-specific security solution design depends on contextual engineering judgement; no labour reduction is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is solution design and verification criteria, excluding implementation, corporate risk acceptance and testing execution.

The system owner supplies existing configuration and operating requirements before analysis. The tester reconciles them in s1 and authors the solution in s2. No new unpaid data preparation or automatic design decision is assumed.
Use existing document and native assessment capabilities; no custom build.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new system or process is added.
research_questions: Which solution design delays come from missing operating constraints rather than document production?

already_counted.description: Constraint analysis and contextual solution design

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross and net0; contextual design work remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Configure systems for least functionality and least access

steps.what: Determine required functionality and access restrictions
Configure approved least functionality and least access settings
Verify restrictions and confirm required services still work

tasks.design: Retain the tester's choice, application and verification of restrictions through the native administration tools in {OTHER}. Record the intended changes, rollback plan and verification results in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: The permitted minimum depends on legitimate service needs and dependencies.
tasks.enabler_now: Native configuration facilities already support applying settings; this proposal claims no new execution saving.
tasks.still_hard: Avoiding broken services and identifying permissions that appear unnecessary but are required.
tasks.human_edge: The tester interprets legitimate usage and verifies that restrictions preserve required service behaviour.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in responsibility for configuration choices and verification.

reach.learn: Identity dependencies and service behaviour testing

evidence.claim: Native administration tools apply configuration, but selecting and validating minimum required access remains contextual work.

assumptions: Boundary is an already authorised configuration change through verification; change authorisation is existing system-owner work outside the boundary.

OTHER means native system administration tools. The system owner provides operating and access requirements and existing change authorisation; the tester checks these and produces exact proposed setting changes and rollback steps in s1. Applying them and interpreting verification are fully counted in s2 and s3.
No new structured configuration feed, automated permission inference or unpaid system-owner task is introduced. Existing native automation is baseline runtime.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new component or recurring work is added.
research_questions: Is configuration effort dominated by selecting and verifying restrictions rather than entering settings?

already_counted.description: Configuration choice, deliberate application and verification

approvals.approved_version: Exact target systems, setting changes, authorisation reference, change window and rollback plan checked before application; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross and net0. Native application runtime is already present and judgement and service verification remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less supported event collation; incident interpretation, device test design and configuration decisions remain with the tester.
reach: Prepare reproducible timelines and explicit remediation verification criteria
role.ambitious_version: A tester whose conclusions and configuration recommendations remain reproducible and grounded in the actual environment.
